findings.message: PostgreSQL service postgres-perf is present.
findings.remediation: Restore the postgres performance service in docker-compose.perf.yml.

findings.message: PostgreSQL max_connections meets the performance-test floor.
findings.remediation: Set the perf PostgreSQL command to include -c max_connections=300 or higher.

findings.message: PostgreSQL shared_buffers meets the performance-test floor.
findings.remediation: Set the perf PostgreSQL command to include -c shared_buffers=1GB or higher.

findings.message: PgBouncer service pgbouncer-perf is present.
findings.remediation: Add the PgBouncer service to the performance compose file.

findings.message: PgBouncer uses transaction pooling.
findings.remediation: Set pool_mode = transaction in pgbouncer/perf.ini.

findings.message: PgBouncer listens on the expected performance port.
findings.remediation: Set listen_port = 6432 in pgbouncer/perf.ini.

findings.message: PgBouncer caps server connections below the target safe budget.
findings.remediation: Lower max_db_connections or raise the explicit PostgreSQL performance capacity profile.

findings.message: Backend routes PostgreSQL traffic through PgBouncer.
findings.remediation: Apply infra/perf/docker-compose.pgbouncer.override.yml or set POSTGRES_HOST=pgbouncer-perf.

findings.message: Backend uses the PgBouncer port.
findings.remediation: Apply the PgBouncer override or set POSTGRES_PORT=6432.

findings.message: Backend per-worker DB pool stays within the combined-test target.
findings.remediation: Set DB_POOL_SIZE=2 for combined legacy plus Go performance tests.

findings.message: Backend disables DB pool overflow for the performance profile.
findings.remediation: Set DB_MAX_OVERFLOW=0.

findings.message: Backend worker count matches the target high-concurrency profile.
findings.remediation: Set GUNICORN_WORKERS=24 for this performance profile or update the connection budget.

findings.message: Backend startup is ordered after PgBouncer in the proposed profile.
findings.remediation: Add backend-perf depends_on pgbouncer-perf in the PgBouncer override.
